questions.question: Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam, awarded with the honour of Padma Bhushan by the Government of India, is known for his brilliant performance and choreography in which for the following styles of Indian classical dances?
questions.solution: Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam was a titan of Kuchipudi who refined the dance form and gave it a distinct classical identity. He founded the Kuchipudi Art Academy in Chennai and was honored with the Padma Bhushan in 1998 for his revolutionary choreography and teaching.

questions.question: Vidyagauri Adkar is associated with _________ classical dance form.
questions.solution: Vidyagauri Adkar is an accomplished Kathak dancer belonging to the Jaipur Gharana. She is known for her mastery over complex rhythmic patterns (layakari) and powerful footwork, characteristic of her school of dance.

questions.question: Yamini Krishnamurthy, who received the Padma Vibhushan Award in 2016, is an Indian dancer in which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Yamini Krishnamurthy is a legendary figure who excels in Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi. She was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2016 and has been a leading force in popularizing these South Indian classical forms globally.

questions.question: Guru MK Saroja has been conferred with the Padma Shri for the relentless pursuit of which of the following dances?
questions.solution: Guru M.K. Saroja was a veteran Bharatanatyam exponent of the Vazhuvoor style. She was awarded the Padma Shri for her lifelong dedication to teaching and preserving the traditional purity of the dance form.

questions.question: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma was an exponent of which Indian classical dance form?
questions.solution: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma was a legendary Kuchipudi performer, most famous for his unparalleled portrayal of female roles, particularly that of Satyabhama in 'Bhama Kalapam'. He is a recipient of the Padma Shri and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.

questions.question: Dr. Purushottam Dadheech, who was awarded the prestigious Padma Shri award in 2020, is associated with which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Dr. Purushottam Dadheech is a renowned Kathak dancer, choreographer, and scholar. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2020 for his extensive research and for reviving the Shastriya (scriptural) aspects of Kathak through the lens of the Natya Shastra.

questions.question: Maguni Charan Das was awarded Padma Shri for his contribution to which of the following forms of dances?
questions.solution: Maguni Charan Das was a master of Gotipua, the precursor to Odissi dance. He was awarded the Padma Shri for his contribution to preserving this traditional dance form from Odisha where young boys dress as women to praise Lord Jagannath.

questions.question: Alarmel Velli is recognised as a classical dancer of ________ dance form.
questions.solution: Alarmel Valli is a world-renowned Bharatanatyam dancer and choreographer known for her Pandanallur style. She is celebrated for her 'visual poetry' and for bringing a high degree of lyricism and grace to the classical stage.

questions.question: Which of the following dance forms is performed by Sonal Mansingh?
questions.solution: Sonal Mansingh is a distinguished Indian classical dancer who has achieved mastery in both Bharatanatyam and Odissi. She is a recipient of the Padma Vibhushan and is known for her socially relevant choreographic themes.

questions.question: Name the classical dancer who is associated with the Kuchipudi classical dance.
questions.solution: Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam is synonymous with the global spread of Kuchipudi. He transformed it from a traditional dance-drama into a sophisticated solo classical form, training countless students at his Chennai academy.

questions.question: Who among the following is a 19th century exponent of the Kathak dance?
questions.solution: Kalka Prasad was a legendary 19th-century exponent of Kathak. Along with his brother Binadin Prasad, he laid the foundation for the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana, emphasizing the Bhava (emotional) aspect of the dance.

questions.question: Which of the following names belong to Bharatanatyam ?
questions.solution: Dr. Narthaki Natraj is an eminent Bharatanatyam dancer. In 2019, she became the first transgender woman to be awarded the Padma Shri. She specializes in the Tanjore Nayaki Bhava tradition.

questions.question: Padma Bhushan Kumudini Lakhia is a _________ dancer.
questions.solution: Kumudini Lakhia is a pioneer of Kathak choreography. She founded the Kadamb Centre for Dance in Ahmedabad and is credited with moving Kathak away from solo traditional narratives toward innovative ensemble work.

questions.question: Which dancer was awarded in 1968 with a gold medal by the Mexican Government for her choreography for the Ballet Folklorico of Mexico?
questions.solution: Mrinalini Sarabhai was an iconic dancer and choreographer who received a gold medal from the Mexican Government in 1968 for her work with the Ballet Folklorico of Mexico. She was the founder of the Darpana Academy of Performing Arts.

questions.question: Held in the month of __________, the Ellora Ajanta Dance Festival is an interface between the culture and history of India.
questions.solution: The Ellora Ajanta Dance Festival is a grand cultural event held annually in January (though dates can occasionally shift to February) in Aurangabad, Maharashtra. It showcases India's finest classical dancers against the backdrop of the historic caves.

questions.question: Bala Saraswati was a prominent exponent of which classical dance form?
questions.solution: T. Balasaraswati was a legendary Bharatanatyam dancer who belonged to a direct lineage of temple dancers. She was instrumental in taking the dance form to international stages and was a staunch defender of the traditional Sadir roots.

questions.question: V Satyanarayana Sarma is recognised as a __________ classical dancer.
questions.solution: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sarma is recognized as a master of Kuchipudi. His ability to evoke Srungara Rasa (the sentiment of love) in female roles made him a household name in the classical arts community.

questions.question: Who among the following personalities has been conferred the prestigious Padma Shri Award for his contribution to Folk Dance form Panthi?
questions.solution: Dr. Radhe Shyam Barle was awarded the Padma Shri in 2021 for his contribution to Panthi, a traditional folk dance of the Satnami community in Chhattisgarh. Panthi dance is characterized by acrobatic movements and spiritual chants.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
questions.solution: Guru Bipin Singh was an exponent of Manipuri dance, not Kuchipudi. He is often called the 'Father of modern Manipuri dance'. The other pairs—Uday Shankar (Fusion), Birju Maharaj (Kathak), and Kelucharan Mohapatra (Odissi)—are correctly matched.

questions.question: Rajkumar Singhajit Singh was awarded the Padma Shri in 1986 for his contribution to which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Rajkumar Singhajit Singh is a leading exponent, choreographer, and guru of Manipuri dance. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 1986 for his creative work in the Jagoi style and his efforts in staging Manipuri dance dramas.

questions.question: Who among the following Padma Bhushan Awardee dance legends has created a new dance form by the name of Bharat Nrityam?
questions.solution: Dr. Padma Subrahmanyam created the style Bharata Nrityam. It is a reconstruction of ancient Indian dance movements (Karanas) found in the Natya Shastra, blended with contemporary Bharatanatyam techniques.

questions.question: Who is the first classical dancer of foreign origin who was conferred the Padma Shri in 2006 for her contributions to Odissi?
questions.solution: Ileana Citaristi is an Italian-born dancer who made India her home. She was the first classical dancer of foreign origin to be conferred the Padma Shri (2006) for her immense contribution to Odissi and Mayurbhanj Chhau.

questions.question: __________ was the first woman dancer to receive the Padma Vibhushan, the nation’s second-highest civilian award.
questions.solution: Tanjore Balasaraswati (T. Balasaraswati) was the first woman dancer to receive the Padma Vibhushan (1977). She was a monumental figure in 20th-century Bharatanatyam, known for her unmatched Abhinaya.

questions.question: Padma Shri awardee Ileana Citaristi, an Italy born Indian dance exponent was conferred the award for her major contribution to which of the following dances?
questions.solution: Ileana Citaristi is celebrated for her mastery of Odissi. A disciple of Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra, she has authored books on Indian dance and runs an academy in Bhubaneswar to train dancers from across the world.

questions.question: Manjusree Chatterjee was awarded with the honour of Padma Shri in 2019 for which of the following styles of dance?
questions.solution: Manjusree Chatterjee is a distinguished Kathak dancer of the Lucknow Gharana. She was awarded the Padma Shri in 2019 for her lifelong contribution to performing and teaching the intricate nuances of Kathak.
